thread:
viv: quick flag from a community customer: the Console observability dashboard example uses `cacheTTL: 0` to show disabling KV cache but when they applied it in staging they still saw cache hits for ~20s. can someone confirm what's canonical now?

ana: yep saw this before. runtime proto and SDK changes made numeric zeros get omitted in the wire format, so the runtime falls back to its default TTL. docs should show the nullable form.

chad: which page? i'll take a look.

viv: docs/console/observability/dashboards-kvcache.md (around the "disable example"). current snippet:
```yaml
kvCache:
  enabled: true
  cacheTTL: 0  # meant to show disable in example
```

ana: simple docs fix: change to `cacheTTL: null` and add a note in migrations noting that runtimes < v2.5 treated 0 as disable while >= v2.5 require null. also add a tiny curl showing payload "cacheTTL": null so users can see the JSON.

chad: ok i'll open a PR. plan: update snippet, add `<!-- id: kvcache-disable-example -->` above code block to stabilize anchor, add migration blurb in docs/migrations/runtime-compatibility.md, and include a short changelog entry. open branch now.

infra-bot: preview build queued for PR 5210.

chad: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5210 — "Console: make KV cache disablement explicit (nullable TTL) + migration note". pushed snippet change and HTML id. added curl example showing payload.

docs-bot: link-check: failure — 1 broken fragment in console/observability/dashboards-kvcache.md.

chad: fixed fragment in TOC and renamed the id to `kvcache-disable-example-1` to avoid clashes. pushed.

infra-bot: preview deployed — https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/pr/5210 — checks: linter OK, link-check pending.

docs-bot: link-check: passed.

viv: LGTM. small nit: migration note references `legacyZeroTtl` as a runtime compatibility flag; public docs use snake_case for flags. can you switch to `legacy_zero_ttl` in example?

chad: changed to `legacy_zero_ttl` in the migration snippet and added a note about which runtime versions are affected (v2.4 -> v2.5). pushed.

viv: thanks. can we also add a one-line docs-linter rule later to warn when examples include `cacheTTL: 0`? prevents copy/paste regressions.

chad: filed issue in docs repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/312 — "lint: warn on examples with numeric 0 for nullable TTLs". putting it in next sprint.

docs-bot: PR 5210 merged into main and backport opened to release/2.x as #5212.

viv: awesome, thanks all. closing thread once backport merges. :white_check_mark:
